# CrewDay

> CrewDay is a platform where organisers host small social events in Bengaluru, India (game nights, walks, café meet-ups, workshops, sports) and people who are new to the city, or just want friends offline, join them for ₹49–₹99. You book a seat on the website or the Android app, pay by UPI or online through Razorpay, and show a QR ticket at the venue. Participants must be 18 or older.

## What CrewDay is
- [Explore events](https://crewday.nirmaansolutions.in/explore): upcoming small events in Bengaluru, each with date, venue, price and seats left.
- [About CrewDay](https://crewday.nirmaansolutions.in/about): who it is for and how it works.
- [Plan my CrewDay](https://crewday.nirmaansolutions.in/plan): a short question flow that suggests matching events.

## How booking works
- Event tickets cost ₹49–₹99. Some events are free.
- Pay by UPI directly to the organiser, or online through Razorpay (cards, UPI, net banking, wallets).
- A paid seat is held while payment is pending and confirmed when the payment is received. The ticket (a QR code) appears in the app under My events.
- Cancel at least 24 hours before the event starts for a full refund. Cancellations later than that and no-shows are not refunded. If an organiser cancels an event, every ticket is refunded in full.

## For organisers
- Organisers create events, set a price and capacity, confirm payments and check attendees in by scanning QR tickets. To host an event on CrewDay, get in touch through [Contact](https://crewday.nirmaansolutions.in/contact).
